teaser: Three bolts, sorted by size, sit in a jar before the job even starts. You are a 4, the number of foundations, and an ISTP, a type that trusts its hands before it trusts a theory. In you, the discipline of the number meets a habit of taking things apart just to see how they work. The 4 wants the structure finished and sound; the ISTP in you wants to know it from the inside, bolt by bolt. What is particular here is a steadiness that looks loose from outside — unhurried, informal — but underneath it runs a system nobody built by accident.
excerpt: Shifting weight from one foot to the other near the front of a voting line, you check a watch instead of the person standing alongside.
